scope: Single causal signed elapsed-age attention-bias candidate on the separate-key Hard-LMM; authorized local implementation/tests/commit plus 5090 CUDA/full e1 only

candidate.label: TitanTPP-HardLMM Causal Elapsed-Age Bias
candidate.only_change_vs_mechanism_reference: Eight zero-initialized signed scalars add causal normalized elapsed-age minus event-rank-age geometry to encoder attention logits

evidence.interpretation: Prospectively balanced train-internal short-history body groups show larger errors for larger J; supports testing the geometry hypothesis without claiming causal encoder deficiency or expected performance gain

geometry.formula: B[b,i,j] = (S[b,i]-S[b,j])/S[b,i] - (r[b,i]-r[b,j])/r[b,i] for valid observed j<=i with r[b,i]>=2 and S[b,i]>0; otherwise zero
geometry.rank: r=cumsum(observed_mask)-1; first observed event has rank0; padded locations are excluded
geometry.prefix_span: S=cumsum(where(observed_mask AND r>0, clamp_min(raw_delta_t,0),0)); both sums include the current observed gap dt[i]
geometry.mask: Use memory_write_mask when provided as the history observation boundary, otherwise validity mask. Require observed_mask to be a subset of validity and reject malformed masks. Selected target and padding are zeroed BEFORE cumulative sums. Each query uses its OWN causal prefix span and rank, never final-window span.
geometry.first_gap: The first retained observed gap may cross the window boundary and is excluded from this geometry. The original log-gap input path remains unchanged.
geometry.time_units: Dimensionless ratios; original raw delta_t unit (Taxi hours, Instacart days) cancels. No new dataset statistics, fixed lookback divisor, train mean, or validation fitting.
geometry.short_or_zero_history: No valid history, first query, H<=2, or zero-span prefix gives zero geometry. Equal internal gaps give mathematical zero.
geometry.pair_boundary: Future, padded, non-observed and persistent-memory key columns have exactly zero bias. Persistent tokens retain their original attention mechanism.
geometry.precision: Finite nonnegative float32-range raw gaps; negative gaps clamped to0 in geometry only. Mask invalid positions before arithmetic. Compute cumulative sums and ratios in float64 outside autocast, emit float32 geometry, cast beta*B to existing attention-score dtype before addition.
geometry.invariance_scope: B is invariant to common positive gap scaling and the excluded first gap; the full model is not, because its existing log-gap input is retained.
geometry.reference_identity: RMS of the last observed query B over its valid observed keys equals the existing age_distortion J within declared float32 tolerance.

attention.location: After QK/sqrt(head_dim), before existing causal/padding masks and softmax
attention.constraint: Unconstrained signed trainable scalars; no softplus, fixed recency sign, gate, projection, additional loss or beta-zero bypass
attention.gradient: Keep beta*B on autograd graph at beta0; nondegenerate irregular histories must provide finite nonzero beta gradients and optimizer updates

initialization.shared_parameters: Exactly the same fresh seed42 RNG draws and parameter values as separate-key; beta zeros consume no RNG
initialization.identity: At beta0 and identical inputs/mode/RNG, equal initial encoder/retrieval/head outputs; no silent conversion or pretrained initialization
initialization.training: All shared parameters and beta trainable with the same original AdamW group; fresh parameters for each dataset
initialization.checkpoint: New backbone/role/contract identity; strict state+metadata+optimizer restoration; legacy separate-key and new checkpoints must not silently cross-load

unchanged.memory: static separate keys and values; no online/contextual update
unchanged.query: existing h without added statistics or projection
unchanged.optimizer: AdamW lr.001 betas(.9,.999) eps1e-8 weight_decay.01 one group time-head multiplier1; grad_clip1
unchanged.data_context: Existing fixed train/validation splits, lookback52/168 and max_seq_len64/256 including target; original train-only body p95 and tail p99 thresholds

prospective_performance_gate_not_evaluat.evaluation_scope: Future separately authorized matched seed42 validation-only screening with original e300/min40/patience40 batch128 lr.001 selector; fresh initialization, no threshold changes after results
prospective_performance_gate_not_evaluat.reference_precision: Use full precision frozen validation_comparison artifacts, not rounded README values; stricter simultaneous bound wins
prospective_performance_gate_not_evaluat.scope_limit: Validation screening relevance only; no held-out, extra seeds, dataset expansion or performance adoption authorized by e1

numerical_tolerances.amp: Check finite forward/backward and preserve original score dtype at beta0; no performance conclusion from mixed precision probes

causal-prefix normalization and target/future/padding leakage barriers
first-gap and common-time-scale invariance of geometry only
